parsed.rationale: The R-R intervals are irregularly irregular (about 70–115 small squares apart in the lead II rhythm strip), there are no clear P waves and the baseline has fine fibrillatory waves, and the QRS complexes are narrow with no ST elevation that meets STEMI criteria (the tall precordial voltages are a secondary finding).
